fusions.name: Tine-Split Flick
fusions.desc: Flicks the blade's tip at the first enemy within 6 tiles, dealing 4 damage. It then splits to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 60% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Both Ways at Once
fusions.desc: Cuts in two directions at once, out to 3 tiles, each cut dealing 7 damage. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Cross Parry
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, 30% of the elemental damage you take is turned aside and dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Second Branch
fusions.desc: Once every 8 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
